name: manual_36f924
claim: gbrain per-source sync ('gbrain sync --source <id>') must run from INSIDE that source's own git repo (its local_path). A bare 'gbrain sync' from a non-git cwd fails: 'Not a git repository: GBrain sync requires a git-initialized repo'. Look up the path via 'gbrain sources list --json' (.local_path) and cd there first.

decisions.notes: 2026-06-22: fixing a blocked sync, a bare 'gbrain sync' from ~/code/OpenClaw (not a git repo) only acked failures and refused to sync; per-source refresh worked only after cd-ing into each source's local_path. Also surfaced that stale sources can be superseded duplicates pointing at OLD moved paths (orama-src/ools/claw/periscope → ~/Documents/... pre-iCloud-escape) — refresh the live canonical source, don't re-index the moved orphan.
